tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Identity. Fresh snow — the reading surface by day.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Identity. Frost on the surface — the faintest ice tint (`surface-frost` by day).

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Identity. Thin, light-filled ice — tinted panels (`surface-ice`) and the cover tint.

tokens.name: glacier
tokens.usage: Identity. THE Glacier colour: light shining through the ice — bright, translucent cyan-blue. The action fill (`accent`) by day, with `ink` text on it (8.7:1).

tokens.name: meltwater
tokens.usage: Identity. Meltwater — the lighter, hover state of glacier; the accent by night (via `accent`, `link`, `deep-accent`).

tokens.name: ice-wall
tokens.usage: Identity. Standing inside the ice: the fill of IssueHero and SubscribeBox by day (via `deep`), with `ink` text.

tokens.name: tarn
tokens.usage: Identity. A glacial tarn — the deep, text-safe blue: links, kickers, focus (≥4.5:1 on all light surfaces).

tokens.name: crevasse
tokens.usage: Identity. The shadow at the bottom of a crevasse — the darkest blue in use: the button on light deep blocks (`deep-accent`), the big number on deep infographics. White text on it 10:1.

tokens.name: abyss
tokens.usage: Identity. Night ice — the darkest tone, used only as `ink` by day and the page by night (via `surface`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The reading surface: page background everywhere. Snow by day, night ice by night.

tokens.name: surface-frost
tokens.usage: Quiet panels: PaperCard, topic tags, code blocks, Notice, the right rail.

tokens.name: surface-ice
tokens.usage: Tinted callouts: KeyFindings. Use `ink`, `ink-secondary`, `link` or `focus` on it — not `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: feed dividers, masthead edge, card borders, gridlines. Pale ice, 1px.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, the secondary button (≥3:1 on `surface` and `surface-frost`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface — a deep blue-black, never pure black (≥12:1).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Deks, labels, chart values — on all surfaces (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata only (dates, read time, captions, axis ticks) on `surface` and `surface-frost` (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action fill: primary Button, Switch on, selected segment, active underline, finding numerals (as a mark), `viz-focus` by night. Bright ice with dark `on-accent` text — a glowing button, never a dark one.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an `accent` or `accent-hover` fill (≥8.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, DOIs, the active nav/tab text colour, finding numerals as text — on all surfaces (≥4.5:1). Underlined.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset (≥3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: glacial
tokens.usage: Marks and small labels: the StrataRule, the kicker above an article title (4.4:1 — 13px bold, fine for a kicker; use `link` for body-size text), icons, the infographic strata mark.

tokens.name: alpenglow
tokens.usage: Dawn light on the ice — the editor's voice: the Insight label and the New marker only, one per screen. Text on `surface` and `alpenglow-soft`.

tokens.name: alpenglow-soft
tokens.usage: Reader highlights (`<mark>`) behind `ink` text, and the New marker behind `alpenglow` text.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Inside the glacier: the fill of IssueHero, SubscribeBox and deep infographics. Luminous pale ice by day (dark text), lit mid-blue by night (white text).

tokens.name: deep-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim around deep blocks.

tokens.name: deep-strata
tokens.usage: Decorative strata lines drawn inside deep blocks. Never text.

tokens.name: deep-glint
tokens.usage: The three lines in a deep block that catch the light.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Titles on `deep` (≥10:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Body and metadata on `deep` (≥6.6:1).

tokens.name: deep-accent
tokens.usage: On `deep`: the kicker text and the button fill. Dark crevasse on pale ice by day; meltwater on blue by night (≥3:1 as a mark, ≥4.5:1 as text).

tokens.name: deep-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a `deep-accent` fill.

tokens.name: on-deep-accent
tokens.usage: Label on a `deep-accent` fill (≥9:1).

tokens.name: deep-field
tokens.usage: Email input background inside deep blocks; `on-deep` text, `on-deep-muted` placeholder.

tokens.name: deep-field-line
tokens.usage: Email input border inside deep blocks (≥3.7:1 against `deep`).

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Status: good / success / complete. Icon + word always (never colour alone). Text-safe on `surface` and `surface-frost` (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Status: warning / provisional data / revision pending. Icon + word always. Text-safe on `surface` and `surface-frost` (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: status-serious
tokens.usage: Status: serious / degraded. Icon + word always. Text on `surface` only (4.6:1); use as an icon colour elsewhere.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Status: critical / error / failed. Icon + word always. Text-safe on all surfaces (≥6:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors — an alias of `status-critical`, always with a sentence of text.

tokens.name: delta-good
tokens.usage: Delta text when the change is good for the reader (e.g. unemployment down). Always with sign and arrow.

tokens.name: delta-bad
tokens.usage: Delta text when the change is bad (e.g. inflation above target and rising). Always with sign and arrow.

tokens.name: delta-rise
tokens.usage: Market prices that rose — international convention (green up). Inside `[data-market="kr"]` the bundle swaps it to `status-critical` (Korean convention: red up).

tokens.name: delta-fall
tokens.usage: Market prices that fell — international convention (red down). Inside `[data-market="kr"]` the bundle swaps it to `link` (Korean convention: blue down).

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 — Glacier blue, bright and saturated. Single-series charts use this slot. Order viz-1→viz-8 is fixed and validated (CVD + normal vision, adjacent pairs, both themes); never reorder or cycle.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 — Alpenglow orange.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 — Glacial lake. Slots 1–3 also validate all-pairs: scatter, maps and small multiples cap at three series.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 — Moraine ochre. From 4 series on, direct labels are mandatory.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 — Heather.

tokens.name: viz-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 — Lichen.

tokens.name: viz-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7 — Dusk violet.

tokens.name: viz-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8 — Alpenrose. The last slot; a 9th series folds into 'Other' (`viz-context`) or small multiples.

tokens.name: viz-focus
tokens.usage: Emphasis form: the one series the story is about — deep tarn by day, glowing meltwater by night. Pair only with `viz-context`, never with viz-1…8.

tokens.name: viz-context
tokens.usage: De-emphasised series, 'Other', comparison countries, sparklines (≥3:1 as a mark).

tokens.name: viz-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines: 1px solid, horizontal only.

tokens.name: viz-axis
tokens.usage: The zero baseline and axis rule: 1px solid. Darker than grid so zero is findable.

tokens.name: viz-band
tokens.usage: Shaded periods behind a time series: recessions, crisis windows, forecast horizon. Label every band in text.

tokens.name: seq-100
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp (magnitude: heatmaps, choropleths, ordered bins), lowest step — may recede into the surface. One hue, light→dark; in the dark theme the anchor flips (low = dark, high = light).

tokens.name: seq-200
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp. For ordinal marks (tiers, funnel stages) start at seq-300 so the lightest mark still clears 2:1.

tokens.name: seq-300
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp.

tokens.name: seq-400
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp.

tokens.name: seq-500
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp.

tokens.name: seq-600
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp.

tokens.name: seq-700
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, highest step.

tokens.name: div-neg-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, strongest below the baseline (alpenglow arm): e.g. growth far below trend.

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, below the baseline.

tokens.name: div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, slightly below.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint — a neutral grey that reads as 'no change'. Never a hue.

tokens.name: div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, slightly above.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, above the baseline (glacier arm). Also the bar colour for positive values in diverging bars.

tokens.name: div-pos-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, strongest above the baseline.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags; between title and dek in cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Byline avatar gap; space under h2.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding; meta-row gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile; panel padding; feed item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Paragraph gap in articles; gap between card text and thumbnail.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above h2 in articles; around figures, Insight and KeyFindings; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; IssueHero vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between feed column and right rail; above the footer.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Figures and full-bleed images — ice has hard edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, JEL code chips, inputs in forms.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels: PaperCard, KeyFindings, SubscribeBox.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, topic tags, the email field.

shadow.note: Glacier separates with hairlines, not shadows. One shadow exists, for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the sticky header once scrolled. Never on cards.

layout.note: Widths for the reading column, feed and page shell. Medium-like proportions.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of article text, ArticleHeader and column figures (≈70 characters at `body`).

tokens.name: width-feed
tokens.usage: Max width of the feed column on Home, Issue and Topic pages.

tokens.name: width-rail
tokens.usage: Right rail on Home at ≥1080px: topics, SubscribeBox, about.

tokens.name: width-wide
tokens.usage: Wide figures that break out of the measure.

tokens.name: width-page
tokens.usage: Max width of the page shell (feed + gap + rail + gutters).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Masthead height.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every page below 904px; 48px (`space-7`) at and above.

tokens.name: width-dashboard
tokens.usage: Max width of dashboard pages (12-column grid, `space-5` gaps).

tokens.name: chart-height
tokens.usage: Default plot height in ChartCard (plus the x-axis band).

tokens.name: chart-height-lg
tokens.usage: Lead chart of a dashboard or a wide figure.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects and segmented controls.

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first min-width queries. CSS variables do not work inside media queries — copy the numbers.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: thumbnails grow to 160px, headline sizes step up.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: gutter becomes 48px, full nav shows.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide: the right rail appears on Home.

tokens.usage: Sticky Masthead and the dashboard filter bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Select menus, popovers.

tokens.name: z-tooltip

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Transient notices.

tokens.name: opacity-area
tokens.usage: Area fill under a line: the series colour at 10%.

tokens.name: opacity-refetch

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
